title: Ford Checked 36,000 EV Batteries After 5 Years #shorts

scenes.text: Everyone says E V batteries die after a few years. Ford just checked thirty-six thousand of them.
Every twenty twenty-one Mustang Mach-E. Five years, two billion miles. Average battery health: ninety-two percent.
Past a hundred thousand miles? Still above ninety-one. Past two hundred thousand? Eighty-eight.
So a Mach-E rated for three hundred five miles now gets roughly two hundred eighty.
Independent tests agree: most E Vs keep ninety to ninety-four percent after ninety-three thousand miles.
The catch: this is Ford's own data. And heat, plus lots of fast charging to a hundred percent, wears batteries faster.
So, would you buy a five-year-old used E V? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
